About the Role

Join an early-stage sales team at a data and infrastructure company, partnering with the sales director to turn technical interest into qualified business opportunities. This hands-on role offers the chance to learn the full sales cycle while helping build repeatable processes.

What You'll Do

  • Identify and engage prospective customers using product adoption, community participation, cloud sign-ups, and other intent signals.

  • Research organizations, engineering teams, technology stacks, and potential use cases.

  • Personalize outreach across email, LinkedIn, Slack, and other channels to generate qualified opportunities.

  • Participate in discovery calls, technical evaluations, product demonstrations, and commercial negotiations.

  • Take ownership of smaller accounts over time, managing sales from initial outreach through contract execution.

  • Work with solutions architects and engineers to understand customer needs and support evaluations.

  • Test prospecting strategies, messaging, tools, and channels to improve efficiency.

  • Help build sales processes and playbooks, and share customer feedback with product and engineering teams.

What We're Looking For

  • Zero to two years of professional experience, or a final-year student or recent graduate.

  • Prior internship or work experience in B2B SaaS sales, business development, or a customer-facing technical role.

  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with curiosity about software and data infrastructure.

  • Initiative, organization, resourcefulness, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a developing environment.

  • A competitive, coachable mindset and willingness to experiment, learn quickly, and improve.

  • Familiarity with databases, cloud computing, data infrastructure, or developer tools is helpful but not required.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary is $60,000 to $80,000 annually, plus commission. Target OTE (on-target earnings, base plus variable) is approximately $120,000 to $160,000.

Location

On-site. A specific city or location was not provided.

Compensation Range: $60K - $80K
